program.section_heading: Certificate of Completion in Graphic and Interactive Design
outcomes: Create professional-quality visual content that demonstrates effective use of design principles, typography, color theory, and composition.
Apply industry-standard software and production workflows to complete digital illustration, graphic design, and web design projects.
Integrate design thinking and creative-technical skills to produce cohesive branding, marketing, and interactive design solutions tailored to diverse audiences and user needs.
Evaluate and refine design solutions by assessing their effectiveness, technical accuracy, and alignment with client or audience needs.
